# Load Libraries
```{julia}
using Pumas
using Random
using Distributions
using LinearAlgebra
using Statistics
using Bioequivalance
```

# Set Random seed

```{julia}
Random.seed!(123)
```

# Model
```{julia}
pkmodel = @model begin
  @param begin
    tvcl ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
    tvv  ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
    tvka ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
    tvbio ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
    Ω ∈ PDiagDomain(3)
    σ ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
  end

  @random begin
    η ~ MvNormal(Ω)
  end

  @covariates TRT

  @pre begin
    CL = tvcl * exp(η[1])
    V  = tvv  * exp(η[2])
    Ka = tvka * exp(η[3]) * (TRT == "T" ? tvbio : 1.0)
  end

  @dynamics begin
    Depot'   = -Ka*Depot
    Central' =  Ka*Depot - (CL/V)*Central
  end

  @derived begin
    cp = @. Central/V
    dv ~ @. Normal(cp, σ)
  end
end
```
 

 # Parameter Values

```{julia}

θ_true = (
    tvcl = 5.0,
    tvv  = 50.0,
    tvka = 1.2,
    tvbio = 1.0, 
    Ω    = Diagonal([0.09, 0.09, 0.09]),   # 30% CV IIV
    σ    = 0.2                            # GMR control
)

```

# Simulate TRUE BE DATASET
```{julia}

function simulate_trial(n_per_arm; tvbio=1.0)

    subjects = Subject[]

    for trt in ["R","T"]
        for i in 1:n_per_arm
            push!(subjects,
                Subject(
                    id = length(subjects)+1,
                    events = DosageRegimen(100, time=0),
                    covariates = (TRT = trt,)
                )
            )
        end
    end

    pop = Population(subjects)

    sim = simobs(pkmodel, pop, 
        merge(θ_true, (tvbio=tvbio,));
        obstimes = 0:1:72
    )

    return sim
end
```

# FIT MODEL TO ONE TRIAL

```{julia}

sim_data = simulate_trial(30)
simdf = DataFrame(sim_data)

init = (
    tvcl = 4.5,
    tvv  = 45.0,
    tvka = 1.0,
    tvbio  = 1.0,
    Ω    = Diagonal([0.1,0.1,0.1]),
    σ    = 0.3
)

sim_pop = read_pumas(DataFrame(sim_data),
                      id = :id,
                      time = :time,
                      observations = [:dv],
                      amt = :amt,
                      evid = :evid,
                      covariates = [:TRT],
                      cmt = :cmt)

fit_res = fit(pkmodel, sim_pop, init, Pumas.FOCE())
```

# BE Decision

```{julia}

simdf.route .= "ev"

ncapop = read_nca(simdf,
                id=:id,
                time=:time,
                amt = :amt,
                observations = :dv,
                route = :route,
                group = [:TRT] #,

)

nca_res = run_nca(ncapop)

nca_table1 = nca_res.reportdf

nca_table1.period .= 1

nca_table1.sequence .= nca_table1.TRT


beres = pumas_be(nca_table1)

```

# Virtual BE Simulation Loop
```{julia}
function virtual_be(param_samples, Ω, σ;
                    n_trials=1000,
                    n_per_arm=30,
                    gmr=1.0)

    decisions = Bool[]

    for i in 1:n_trials

        θ = param_samples[rand(1:size(param_samples,1)), :]

        sim = simulate_trial(n_per_arm, θ, Ω, σ; gmr=gmr)

        # compute AUC per subject
        aucs = compute_auc(sim)

        logratios = log.(aucs[TRT .==2]) .-
                    log.(aucs[TRT .==1])

        push!(decisions, tost_decision(logratios))
    end

    return mean(decisions)
end

```


# Power
```{julia}

power = virtual_be(samples, Ω, σ; gmr=1.0)

power = virtual_be(10, 30, 10; gmr=1.0)
```


# Type 1 error
```{julia}

type1 = virtual_be(samples, Ω, σ; gmr=0.75)
```

# Summary
```{julia}
power_vcov = virtual_be(vcov_samples, Ω, σ)
power_boot = virtual_be(boot_mat, Ω, σ)
power_sir  = virtual_be(sir_mat, Ω, σ)
power_fixed = virtual_be([θ̂'], Ω, σ)
```
